- Windows uses explicit best-effort director"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"y-entry durability while file sync, rename and other permission failures remain strict.

- The router is write-denied by default. Worker submissions validate ticke"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"t revisions, input digests and the live workspace lease epoch; the watchdog quarantines unknown side"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" effects and restores quarantine from events.

Route admission now uses DSH's native `ctx.tokenMeter`, `contextWindow`, and `defau"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ltMaxTokens`, skips unsafe routes, and fails before dispatch when no candidate can hold the session."},{"id":"p15s4","text":"
